unit_count_pattern: tests passed, \d+ tests failed out of (\d+)
description: Ordinary project checks only. check.py wraps the CI-equivalent commands (clang-format-18 over the full scanned file set; cmake+Ninja build; full ctest incl. imgui_test_engine UI suite) as single shell-free argv for ci.py, and works in a fresh candidate worktree with no build/ directory.
